description.text: The second Pokémon TCG Battle Academy, released in early 2022: three ready-to-play 60-card decks led by Cinderace V, Pikachu V and Eevee V, so two players can battle with Cinderace or Pikachu and then switch to Eevee. The Eevee deck held two copies of a new Galarian Obstagoon promo. Tutorial guides for the decks, three deck boxes, a large metallic coin and a code card for the online game came with it. Its cards reprint cards of the Sword & Shield expansions, and those of the Cinderace and Pikachu decks carry their deck's silhouette mark with a number.
